turns.text: Look at the suppliers of the 8 SKUs that sold the most units in Q3 2026. For each distinct supplier compare the lead time in the supplier master with the one quoted on the supplier portal. How many of them disagree, which supplier has the largest gap, and how many days is that gap?
turns.answer:
**One supplier disagrees: Tirupur Apparel (SUP-13), with a 7-day gap.**

Its supplier master lead time is 36 days and its portal quote is 43 days. The other seven suppliers quote the same lead time in both places.

I took Q3 2026 as 1 July to 30 September and ranked SKUs by units sold across all stores. The eight suppliers, with master vs portal lead times in days:

| Supplier | Top SKU | Master | Portal | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Leeds Textiles (SUP-16) | Floral Wrap Dress Camel | 32 | 32 | 0 |
| Lyon Mills (SUP-19) | Knit Chelsea Boot Cream | 38 | 38 | 0 |
| Hanoi Mills (SUP-24) | Trail Sandal Forest | 34 | 34 | 0 |
| Prato Knit Co (SUP-22) | Floral Shirt Dress Forest | 21 | 21 | 0 |
| Hanoi Mills (SUP-09) | Stretch Skirt Navy | 29 | 29 | 0 |
| Bursa Textiles (SUP-06) | Stonewash Denim Jacket Navy | 12 | 12 | 0 |
| Tirupur Apparel (SUP-13) | Oxford Polo Black | 36 | 43 | **7** |
| Porto Knit Co (SUP-17) | Cotton Crew Sweater Forest | 38 | 38 | 0 |

Hanoi Mills appears under two IDs (SUP-24 and SUP-09). I kept both because they came up as separate suppliers, and both match, so the count of disagreeing suppliers is unaffected.

turns.text: Gross profit is revenue minus units x the SKU's unit cost. Compute Q3 2026 gross profit for every category from the sales lines and the catalogue, and give the top 3 categories with their gross profit.
turns.answer:
The top 3 categories by Q3 2026 gross profit (1 July to 30 September 2026) are:

1. **Footwear: £601,745.67**
2. **Knitwear: £591,060.96**
3. **Activewear: £515,888.11**

Gross profit is revenue minus units × unit cost, taken across all 1,948 SKUs that sold in the quarter. Every SKU matched a catalogue entry, so no sales were left out.

For reference, the other five categories are Dresses (£502,545.95), Denim (£414,078.20), Shirts (£392,177.92), Outerwear (£370,601.54) and Accessories (£332,943.37).
